reconciliation.description: A dark-themed desktop browser window showing a YouTube video watch page with a video player displaying startup logos, video metadata below it, and recommended videos on the right.

regions.context: Complete browser application window with the YouTube interface loaded.
Top browser chrome featuring macOS window control buttons, tab bar with multiple open tabs, and URL navigation bar.
YouTube top header containing the YouTube Premium logo, search bar, microphone icon, Create button, notification bell, and user profile avatar.
Main video playback viewport showing a slide with 'FOUNDERS FUND' and various portfolio company logos (Polymarket, Lighter, Figma, Varda, etc.).
Video metadata section including video title, channel information ('Sourcery with Molly O'Shea'), subscribe button, engagement controls (like/dislike/share), and description panel.
Right sidebar presenting category filter pills and a vertical list of recommended videos from 'Sourcery with Molly O'Shea'.
